children: ON THE EVENING OF SEPTEMBER 3, THE POLICE INFORMED RWE ABOUT THE DISCOVERY OF FIRING DEVICES IN THE AREA OF THE SUBSTATION NEAR DORMAGEN, NORTHEAST OF THE RWE NEURATH POWER PLANT
